offload.heading: GPU offload (this load)
offload.all: All {{layers}} layers run on the GPU.
offload.partial: {{gpu}} of {{total}} layers run on the GPU; the rest run on the CPU, which is slower.
offload.none: No layers run on the GPU: the model is running on the CPU.
offload.unknown: The engine did not say how many layers it offloaded.
offload.memory: Model weights: {{gpu}} on the GPU, {{cpu}} in system memory.

evidence.ran-successfully: Ran successfully on this device with these settings.
evidence.failed-with-settings: Failed on this device with these settings. Other settings may work.
evidence.unsupported: Unsupported by this runtime: the llama.cpp engine in this version of Flint does not recognise the model's architecture. Changing settings will not help; an app update might.
evidence.stale: Tested before, but something has changed since, so that result may not apply.

verdict.fits-partial-offload: Estimated to fit, with part of the model running on the CPU. It will work but respond more slowly.
verdict.tight: May require adjusted settings: very little memory would be left. A smaller context size helps.
verdict.exceeds: Estimated not to fit. Estimates can be wrong; you can still try it or test it.

memoryModel.unified: Unified memory: {{ram}} shared by the CPU and GPU. By default the GPU can use about {{gpu}} of it.
memoryModel.discrete-gpu: Dedicated GPU memory {{vram}} plus {{ram}} of system memory. Layers that do not fit on the GPU run on the CPU.
memoryModel.integrated-gpu: Integrated graphics share the {{ram}} of system memory, so it is counted once.
memoryModel.cpu-only: No GPU was detected for this runtime: the model runs on the CPU using {{ram}} of system memory.
memoryModel.unknown: Device memory has not been detected yet.

breakdown.otherLoaded: Already used by other loaded models

assumption.kv-from-metadata: Conversation memory is calculated from the model's own architecture and the configured cache types.
assumption.kv-heuristic: The model's architecture could not be read, so conversation memory is approximated from the file size.
assumption.kv-sliding-window-midpoint: This model keeps only recent tokens in some layers; the exact split is unknown, so the midpoint is used.
assumption.context-capped-to-trained: The context size is capped at what the model was trained for.
assumption.unified-gpu-working-set: macOS limits how much unified memory the GPU uses by default; beyond that, layers run on the CPU.
assumption.integrated-gpu-shares-ram: Integrated graphics memory is part of system memory and is not added on top of it.
assumption.discrete-vram-reserve: About 512 MB per dedicated GPU is left for the driver and display.
assumption.system-reserve: About 2 GB of system memory is left for the operating system and other apps.
assumption.runtime-overhead: Compute buffers and the runtime are estimated at 300 MB plus 2% of the model file.
assumption.cpu-only-by-setting: GPU layers are set to 0, so the GPU is not used.
assumption.other-models-loaded: Models already loaded are subtracted, but where they sit (GPU or CPU) is not observable.
assumption.mmap-not-counted: Memory-mapped loading can let a model start in less memory than shown, at a large speed cost; that is not counted.
assumption.mmproj-unknown: A vision component exists but its size is unknown.

uncertainty.low: Confidence: reasonably good. Real use can still differ.
uncertainty.medium: Confidence: moderate. Testing on this device gives a real answer.
uncertainty.high: Confidence: low. The result is close to the limit or rests on rough assumptions; test it to know.

difference.runtime: The app was updated since the test ({{recorded}} to {{current}}).
difference.device: The device's memory or GPU configuration changed.

otherSuccess: It did run on this device with a context size of {{context}}.
testScope: A test proves only a short reply with the settings used. Longer conversations, larger context or other loaded models can still run out of memory.

test.running: Testing: loading the model and asking for a short reply…
test.succeeded: Test passed: the model loaded and replied.
test.cancelled: Test cancelled. Nothing the test loaded is still loaded.
test.cancelledNotReleased: Test cancelled, but the model could not be unloaded. Unload it from the model settings.
test.notReleased: The model could not be unloaded afterwards; it is still using memory.
test.blockedBusy: Not tested: {{models}} is writing a reply, and testing would have to unload it. Try again when it has finished. Nothing was changed.
test.blockedInProgress: Another model test is already running. Nothing was changed.
test.notRestored: {{models}} could not be loaded again; load it from the model settings.
test.needsConfirmation: Testing needs to unload another model first.
test.confirmUnload: To test, Flint has to unload {{models}}. Any reply it is generating will stop. It is not reloaded automatically.

testExplainer: Testing uses the model file already on this device; nothing is downloaded. It loads the model with its current settings, asks for a one-word reply, and unloads it again if it was not already loaded.
